title: Miami Celebrity Boat Tours

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Ok, you have made it this far. Lets have fun with your Miami Boat Tours. Why skip the opportunity to jump on a 90 minute Miami Boat tour, departing from Bayside Marketplace? Not! Book your tickets now, explore our beautiful city from the water. Not just that, the Miami Celebrity Boat tour will take on you a big loop around most of our neighbor Islands, full mansions, yachts, Celebrity's, and yes, rich folks. Oh keep in mind, when you are on the tour and you see someone in the Mansions of Miami Beach, wave at them, because here is trick to spot if someone lives there. If they wave back at you, they dont live there. Lol! Rich people never wave back! Now, brace yourself as we glide by the Port

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: A Miami Celebrity Boat Tour is a 90-minute guided cruise in Miami departing from Bayside, operating all year round. Experience 360-degree panoramic views of Miami’s top landmarks, including Star Island, Fisher Island, Venetian Islands, Port of Miami, Miami Beach, South Beach, Virginia Key, Brickell Key, the entrance to the Miami River, and the historic Flagler Monument.
